'''Chen Hualan''' ({{lang-zh|s=陈化兰|t=陳化蘭|p=Chén Huàlán}}; born March 1969) is a Chinese [[Veterinary virology|veterinary virologist]] best known for researching animal epidemic diseases.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Yong |first1=Ed |title=Scientists create hybrid flu that can go airborne|url=http://www.nature.com/news/scientists-create-hybrid-flu-that-can-go-airborne-1.12925|work=Nature|date=2013-05-02|author1-link=Ed Yong}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Genetic Basis for the transmission of H5N1 Avian Influenza Viruses in a Mammalian Host|url=http://www.offlu.net/fileadmin/home/en/meeting-reports/pdf/offlu-annual-meeting-16-17-nov-2010/Laboratory%20presentations%20on%20current%20influenza%20related%20research/Dr%20Hualan%20Chen.pdf|work=offlu.net|access-date=2015-10-10|archive-date=2016-03-04|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304093342/http://www.offlu.net/fileadmin/home/en/meeting-reports/pdf/offlu-annual-meeting-16-17-nov-2010/Laboratory%20presentations%20on%20current%20influenza%20related%20research/Dr%20Hualan%20Chen.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> She is a member of the [[World Organisation for Animal Health]] (OIE) and a member of the [[Food and Agriculture Organization Corporate Statistical Database]] (FAOSTAT). She is now a researcher and PhD Supervisor at Harbin Veterinary Research Institute of [[Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.womenofchina.cn/womenofchina/html1/special/12/6087-1.htm |title=The 7th China Young Female Scientists Award |newspaper=womenofchina.cn |date=2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Connor |first1=Steve |title='Appalling irresponsibility': Senior scientists attack Chinese researchers for creating new strains of influenza virus in veterinary laboratory|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/appalling-irresponsibility-senior-scientists-attack-chinese-researchers-for-creating-new-strains-of-8601658.html|work=[[The Independent]]|date=2013-05-02|accessdate=2018-11-26}}</ref>

She has been listed among the "Ten Scientific Figures of the Year" by ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'' in 2013.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://tech.sina.com.cn/d/2013-12-19/14229021843.shtml |script-title=zh:《自然》评十大科学人物 中国禽流感专家当选 |newspaper=Sina |date=2013-12-19 |language= zh}}</ref> She won the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO Awards for Women in Science]] in 2016,<ref>{{cite news|title=Chen Hualan gewinnt UNESCO-L'Oréal-Preis 2016|url=http://www.bjrundschau.com/Welt/201510/t20151009_800039985.html|work=UNESCO|date=2015-10-09|language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.ifeng.com/a/20151009/44804382_0.shtml |script-title=zh:陈化兰获世界杰出女科学家成就奖 |newspaper=Ifeng |date= 2015-10-09|language=zh }}</ref> and was elected to the [[List of members of the Chinese Academy of Sciences|Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.casad.ac.cn/doc/17503.html |script-title=zh:关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告|date=28 November 2017 |publisher=Chinese Academy of Sciences |accessdate=1 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171202014847/http://www.casad.ac.cn/doc/17503.html|archive-date=2017-12-02}}</ref>
